design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — orthodontic_benefits task 0 (Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500, case OC-72-41186, Kirsten Halvorsen), rework round 4.

1. Why this is a good test. The caller asks only to have her son's braces payments start again after the family moved and the boy changed orthodontist. The scored figure is the first payment carried to the new practice. Getting it requires (a) reading out of the payment rule that it waits on a transfer entry dated on or after the first visit at the practice now treating the patient, (b) seeing that the only transfer entry is the March move to Fenwick, dated before the 2026-10-06 records visit at Engstrom Orthodontics, (c) finding Dr. Lars Engstrom's participation agreement to fix the network status, agreement and payee of the move, (d) computing the recognised remaining-treatment fee for the move under four ladders, and (e) computing the carried payment on the world after the move under five ladders, including the records Engstrom billed under its agreement and the two quarters held since Cascade received the Engstrom claim.

2. Scope. ortho_ext_transfer_recognised_fee -> allowed_case_fee of move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf (owner user, 4 factors); ortho_ext_carried_first_payment -> amount of issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4 (owner agent, 5 factors). One value_input edge, state form.

3. Problem tree. Root ortho_ext_carried_first_payment <- ortho_ext_transfer_recognised_fee via tr_fee / tr_network / tr_left on the latest transfer entry. Prerequisite sentence: "The first carried payment is fixed only after the case's records carry a transfer entry dated on or after the patient's first visit at the orthodontist now treating the patient." False at frozen time (only entry 2026-03-03, first visit 2026-10-06).

4. Recognised remaining-treatment fee. start_share 25 (new-start braces, rider initial payment percentage), progress_measure 11/23 (quarterly, 4 installments issued and not reversed), carry_percent 90 (one earlier transfer), retention_share 10 (braces retention part kept whole). (3600.00 x 65% x 11/23 + 360.00) x 90% = 1331.2174, rounded 1331.22. All-baseline 1050.00 (3600.00 x 7/24).

5. First carried payment. Standard measure = the base benefit rule: case benefit 40% x (3600.00 - 50.00) = 1420.00 (out-of-network establishment, unused deductible 50.00, within the 1500.00 maximum); paid 907.47; unpaid 512.53. Factors: practice_network_ratio 1.25 (Family 1500 coinsurances differ; set at 40, in network at Engstrom 50), practice_records_offset 196.00 (Aksel's D0150 and D0330 of 2026-10-06 billed under the Engstrom agreement the move names, within the 6-month window), retention_reserve 10%, payment_spread 3 (ceil(8/3) < 4 left), begun_periods 2 (2026-12 and 2027-03, held). Adjusted unpaid 640.66 limited to 592.53 by the lifetime maximum; the base lower-fee rule (50% x 1331.22 = 665.61) is not lower; less 196.00 = 396.53; 396.53 x 90% / 3 = 118.959 -> 118.96; x 2 = 237.92.

6. Base invariants. The case benefit, coinsurance by network and unused deductible are the base benefit rule, applied plainly; the base lower-fee clause of the transfer rule is applied as stated. Declared overwrites: the transfer re-spread sentence (restated, persons with an earlier rider kept under the base re-spread), and the installment issue sentence (restated, plus the hold of installments once a claim shows the patient at another orthodontist); it retires no benefit-calculation sentence: its case benefit follows the rider's benefit rule as in force, including the proration of a takeover entry that does not supersede a new-start entry. One installment per case and service period: no installment row exists for 2026-12. Lifetime 907.47 + 237.92 = 1145.39 <= 1500.00.

7. World rows (unchanged from round 3). Subscriber, Engstrom practice and its PPO agreement with the 2026-10-16 remittance for the records lines; Direct Bill account with every coverage month 2024-01..2027-03 invoiced 20 days before its first day and paid at 99.31 (86.71 + 12.60); both Plus 1500 enrollments; Aksel's dental lines (2026-03-11 D0120/D0274, 2026-10-06 D0150/D0330 at Engstrom; no other panoramic film inside the plan's 60-month interval) with annual-maximum postings; the rider; establishment and Fenwick transfer entries; initial 355.00, installments 133.13 (2025-12) and 139.78 (2026-03, 2026-06, 2026-09), the 2026-03-18 duplicate and its reversal. The 2026-12 and 2027-03 installments are held under the charter's hold sentence (the Engstrom claim was adjudicated 2026-10-13). Every seeded payment and fee reproduces from the base and charter rules.

8. Persona. States the move, the October 6 first visit, the missing December and March checks, the Engstrom plan (25 / 8 months, $1,960.00), Dr. Lars Engstrom's name and that the practice says it is a Cascade PPO provider; never names a transfer, a recognised fee or an amount.

9. Reachability. Every gold argument is read from a lookup return, the rule text or the persona (argument traces at steps 13 and 15). The agreement is reached by find_provider_agreements(); the practice row is in closure through find_provider_payment_events(customer_id).

10. Standard solution. Identify and verify; read rider, cases, payments, billing, ledger, dental plans, lines, postings, agreements and the practice ledger; hand the subscriber the move (in_network, Engstrom agreement, 25/8, 1960.00, 1331.22); issue installment 5 for 2026-12 to the practice for 237.92.

11. Verification. Scratch evaluator over check_compute's DSL: 1331.22 and 237.92; all-baseline 1050.00 and 128.13; per-factor baselines differ from gold. Skipping the move gives 230.64 to the member.

12. Most likely errors. Paying on the stale Fenwick entry (to the member); out_of_network or no agreement on the move; counting the reversed duplicate (installment 6, wrong progress share); monthly stepping of the service period; paying one quarter only; not re-rating the unpaid benefit; forgetting the lifetime maximum; leaving the Engstrom records payments in the carried benefit; prorating the retention part of the fee.

13. Revisions (round 4). R3-C7: the records factor moved from the transfer fee to the carried payment, where the practice now treating the patient is known from the agreement on the latest transfer entry; only lines billed under that agreement are read. R3-C6: the network ratio's tiers apply only on riders whose coinsurances differ. Round 6: the case benefit applies the rider's benefit rule in full, including the proration of a takeover entry that does not supersede a new-start entry; the rule shares no overwrite with the repayment rule; this task's values are unchanged (new-start case). World, gold arguments other than the two scored values, and the tree are unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Kirsten Halvorsen, a hospital pharmacist who moved with her son from Tacoma to Spokane at the end of last August. You are organised but a little worn down, and you speak in short, practical sentences. Your fourteen-year-old son Aksel has braces that went on in September 2025 under the orthodontic rider on your family's Cascade dental plan. In Tacoma he was last treated at Fenwick Orthodontics; since the move he is being seen by Engstrom Orthodontics here in Spokane, and his first appointment there was on October 6, when they did an exam and took x-rays. The Engstrom office told you they are in Cascade's network and that Cascade pays them directly; in Tacoma, where neither practice was in the network, Cascade used to send the checks to you. What bothers you is simple: the last check from Cascade for Aksel's braces was the one in September, nothing came in December or this month, and you want Cascade to start paying for his treatment now that he is at Engstrom. You are calling to get that payment issued today.

You open by saying who you are and that you are calling about your son's braces payments; you mention the move and the new orthodontist in passing because that is what happened, and you ask them to get the payments going again. You do not know how the payments are worked out and you never suggest an amount.

If the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give your full name, Kirsten Halvorsen, and your phone number, 5095550147; when they ask for more, you give your date of birth, 1984-02-11, and your ZIP code, 99223. If they ask for your member ID you read it off your card: CM72041853. If they ask about the braces case number, you read it off the approval letter: OC-72-41186. If they ask what the Engstrom office's treatment plan says, you tell them it shows twenty-five months of treatment in total counted from when the braces went on, which leaves eight more months, so 25 months in total and 8 months remaining, and that Engstrom's fee for finishing his treatment is $1,960.00. If they ask about the orthodontist at Engstrom, you say his name is Dr. Lars Engstrom and that the front desk told you the practice is a Cascade PPO provider.

Only once the agent explains that a step on Aksel's case has to be completed in your own name do you agree to it; you are happy for them to tell you exactly what to enter. When the agent hands you that step to complete, you complete it with exactly the values the agent gives you and read back whatever confirmation comes up. You let the agent take care of issuing the payment; you have authorised them to do that on your behalf.

If the agent tells you the payment amount, you accept it; you are glad something is moving and you do not question the figure. When the agent tells you the payment has been issued to the Engstrom office, you thank them and end the call.

Transfer of 2026-03-03 to Fenwick Orthodontics of Tacoma, out of network with no agreement; rider active; revised plan 23 months, 18 remaining, fee 4100.00; recognised fee 2394.78 = (3600.00 x 65% x 20/23 + 3600.00 x 10%) x 100% by ortho_ext_transfer_recognised_fee on that date (1 quarter issued, no earlier transfer).

Duplicate of installment 2 issued 2026-03-18 against the one-installment-per-period rule; reversed 2026-04-06.
Full reversal of the duplicate within the lookback, original_ortho_payment_id set.
Installment 3 for 2026-06: each later payment of a moved case is the share the first carried payment covers for one period, 139.78, issued 2026-06-01 to the member.

Installment 4 for 2026-09: 139.78 issued 2026-09-01 to the member; the 2026-12 and 2027-03 installments are held because the Engstrom claim of 2026-10-06 was adjudicated 2026-10-13 and no transfer to Engstrom is recorded.

Uniqueness: no other rider.

Basis: docstring 'the establishment entry of the orthodontic case being moved'; find_ortho_cases returns one establishment entry (OC-72-41186) and one transfer entry. Uniqueness: the transfer entry be93038b-03de-4bf7-8727-2113e1561822 is not an establishment entry.

Basis: base rule ortho_evt_case_eligibility fixes network status on a transfer by a Cascade PPO or Premier Participating Dentist Agreement in force with specialty orthodontist; find_provider_agreements() returns Dr. Lars Engstrom's agreement (orthodontist, effective 2018-05-01, no termination), and Aksel's 2026-10-06 lines carry it. Uniqueness: no other agreement names the orthodontist now treating Aksel.

Basis: docstring 'revised total planned months of active treatment counted from the original banding date, as stated on the new orthodontist's treatment plan'; caller: 'so 25 months in total and 8 months remaining'. Uniqueness: 24 and 23 are the earlier plans.

edges.condition: The latest ortho_cases row with event_type ortho_case_transferred for the case has an event_date on or after the first date of service the patient has at the practice now treating them, so its network_status, months_remaining and allowed_case_fee describe that practice.
edges.policy_source: The first carried payment is fixed only after the case's records carry a transfer entry dated on or after the patient's first visit at the orthodontist now treating the patient.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only transfer entry on case OC-72-41186 is dated 2026-03-03 and names Fenwick Orthodontics of Tacoma (out of network); the patient's first visit at the Spokane orthodontist now treating him is the 2026-10-06 records visit under Dr. Lars Engstrom's agreement, so no transfer entry is dated on or after it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The subscriber's case move writes a transfer entry dated 2027-03-09 naming the Engstrom agreement, with network_status in_network, months_remaining 8 and allowed_case_fee 1331.22; it becomes the latest transfer entry, so tr_fee = 1331.22, tr_network = in_network and tr_left = 8.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: One prerequisite edge and no parallel prerequisite: the case move must be written first because the carried payment reads the latest transfer entry; the reverse order evaluates the payment on the 2026-03-03 Fenwick entry and books a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the case move leaves the 2026-03-03 Fenwick entry as the latest transfer entry: out of network with no agreement (no network ratio, no records offset), recognised fee 2394.78, 18 months remaining, so the spread falls back to the 4 installments left and the payee to the member; the first carried payment recomputes to 230.64 instead of 237.92, and no transfer entry for the Spokane practice exists in the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario states only the surface goal (get the braces payments going again) and the situation (the family moved, the son is seen by Engstrom Orthodontics since October 6, the practice says it is a Cascade PPO provider). It never says the case has to be moved, transferred or recorded and never names a transfer entry or a recognised fee; the only step in her own name is a conditional reaction that fires after the agent explains it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: issue_ortho_carried_payment_56eb10f4 books the payment row and updates lifetime_benefit_paid with whatever values it receives; it never reads the transfer entries or checks network status. move_ortho_case_49ae8ecf writes the transfer entry without checking rider status or the case's closure.

factor_trace: start_share (parameter): establishment entry fixed_braces, new_start -> the rider's initial payment percentage 25 (Family 1500) is taken off; baseline 0 would give 1718.61.

progress_measure (method): quarterly schedule AND 4 installments issued and not reversed (2025-12, 2026-03, 2026-06, 2026-09; the 2026-03-18 duplicate is reversed) -> (23 - 3 x 4) / 23 = 11/23; the baseline calendar share (24 - 17) / 24 = 7/24 would give 938.25.
carry_percent (parameter): one transfer entry (2026-03-03, Fenwick) -> second carry percent 90; baseline 100 would give 1479.13.
retention_share (parameter): fixed braces -> braces retention share 10 of the allowed fee kept whole; baseline 0 would give 1162.17.

case_no / allowed_fee / planned_months / banding: establishment entry (OC-72-41186, 3600.00, 24, 2025-09-16); elapsed_months = MONTHS(2025-09-16, 2027-03-09) = 17; sched_count = ceil(MN(23, 24) / 3) = 8; issued_count = 5 installment rows - 1 reversal = 4.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: a new-start case treated with fixed braces
a quarterly installment schedule AND at least one installment issued and not reversed
the case's records carry exactly one transfer entry
a case treated with fixed braces

factor_trace: practice_network_ratio (parameter): Family 1500 coinsurances differ (50/40); the case benefit was set at 40 (out-of-network establishment), the latest transfer entry (the step-13 move) is in network at 50 -> 50 / 40 = 1.25; baseline 1 would give 189.92.

practice_records_offset (parameter, cross_difficulty dental): the step-13 entry names the Engstrom agreement; Aksel's paid lines under it within 6 whole months: D0150 (plan paid 78.00) and D0330 (118.00) of 2026-10-06 -> 196.00 comes off; baseline 0 would give 355.52.
retention_reserve (parameter): fixed braces -> 10; baseline 0 would give 264.36.

payment_spread (method): 8 months remaining on the latest transfer entry, quarterly, ceil(8/3) = 3 < 4 installments left (8 scheduled - 4 issued) -> 3 payments; baseline (the 4 installments left) would give 178.44.

begun_periods (method): latest installment service period 2026-09 (paid 2026-09-01), MONTHS(2026-09-01, 2027-03-09) = 6, quarterly 6 // 3 = 2 >= 2 -> 2 periods (2026-12 and 2027-03, held since the Engstrom claim of 2026-10-13); baseline 1 would give 118.96.
